description: Popped-out workspace Browser windows (browser-popout-*). Needs its own file rather than riding popout.json: glob matching is prefix-anchored, so 'browser-popout-w_1' does not match 'popout-*'. Mirrors the main window's capability so the webview bootstraps its IPC identically, plus window close/focus/title for self-management. The tunneled page itself lives in a CHILD webview whose origin is Remote, and every capability here declares a Local execution context — so the page cannot reach any of this.
